name: Grilled Lemon-Herb Chicken Breast with Quinoa
directions: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, garlic and salt in a bowl; coat the chicken and marinate for 20 minutes.
Rinse the quinoa, then simmer in 1 cup water for 15 minutes until the germ spirals out; fluff with a fork.
Grill the chicken on a hot ridged pan for 6 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, slice, and serve over the quinoa with diced cucumber.

name: Banana Oat Energy Pancakes
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil for the pan
directions: Blend the banana, oats, eggs, baking powder and cinnamon until the batter is smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush with olive oil.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake and cook 2 minutes until bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook 90 seconds more, then drizzle with honey and eat 45-60 minutes before training.

name: Tandoori Salmon with Sweet Potato Mash
directions: Mix yogurt, tandoori masala and lemon juice; coat the salmon and rest 15 minutes.
Peel and cube the sweet potato; boil 12 minutes until fork-tender, drain and mash with olive oil.
Bake the salmon at 200°C for 12 minutes until it flakes easily.
Plate over the mash and garnish with coriander.

name: Zucchini Noodle Turkey Meatball Bowl
directions: Combine turkey, almond flour, egg white and basil; roll into 6 small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in olive oil for 8 minutes, turning often.
Add garlic and crushed tomatoes; simmer 8 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Sauté the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes only, then top with the meatballs and sauce.

name: Ginger Turmeric Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and carrot in a splash of stock for 5 minutes.
Stir in turmeric and rinsed lentils, then add the stock.
Simmer 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend half the soup for body, stir in lemon juice and serve hot.

name: Chickpea Spinach Coconut Curry
directions: Toast cumin seeds in a dry pan for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook until golden.
Stir in tomato paste and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk; simmer 10 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and serve over brown rice.

name: Shakshuka with Feta and Herbs
directions: Soften the onion and pepper in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add paprika and cumin, then the tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make two wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5-6 minutes.
Crumble feta on top and finish with parsley.

name: Harissa Beef Kofta Lettuce Wraps
directions: Mix the beef, harissa, parsley, grated onion and cumin until tacky, then shape into 6 small ovals.
Sear the koftas in a dry non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side until deeply browned and cooked through.
Stir a pinch of salt into the yogurt to make a cooling sauce.
Spoon 1 to 2 koftas into each lettuce leaf, add cucumber slices and finish with the yogurt.

name: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Bowl
ingredients: 200 g halal chicken thigh, trimmed and cubed
directions: Toss the chicken cubes with lemon juice, oregano, olive oil and salt; marinate 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear for 10 minutes, turning every 2 to 3 minutes until charred at the edges.
Fluff the cooked bulgur and spread across a bowl.
Top with the chicken, tomatoes and red onion, then add a generous spoonful of tzatziki.

name: Cottage Cheese Veggie Egg White Frittata
directions: Preheat the oven to 190°C and grease a small oven-safe skillet with olive oil.
Sauté the bell pepper for 2 minutes, then wilt the spinach for 30 seconds.
Whisk the egg whites, whole egg, cottage cheese, chives and pepper, then pour over the vegetables.
Cook on the stovetop for 2 minutes until the edges set, then bake 10 minutes until puffed and firm in the center.

name: Garlic Lemon Tilapia with Cauliflower Rice
ingredients: 1 tbsp lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest
directions: Pat the tilapia dry and season with paprika and salt.
Heat half the olive oil and sear the fillet 3 minutes per side until opaque; add garlic for the last minute.
Remove the fish and splash lemon juice into the pan to make a quick sauce.
In a second pan, cook the riced cauliflower in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, stir in lemon zest and parsley, and serve under the fish.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Rice Cakes
ingredients: 2 tbsp natural peanut butter (no added sugar)
directions: Spread peanut butter evenly across each rice cake, right to the edges.
Fan banana slices in overlapping rows on top.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Sprinkle chia seeds over the top and eat 30 to 45 minutes before training.

name: Overnight Oats with Berries and Chia
directions: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds and maple syrup together in a jar.
Seal and refrigerate at least 6 hours so the oats and chia soften and thicken.
In the morning, stir well and loosen with a splash of milk if needed.
Top with the berries and eat 60 to 90 minutes before exercise.

name: Date and Almond Greek Yogurt Energy Bowl
directions: Spoon the yogurt into a wide bowl and stir in the cardamom.
Scatter the chopped dates across one side of the bowl.
Add the banana slices and granola on the other side.
Finish with the almonds and eat about an hour before your session.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
directions: Combine coconut aminos, honey, ginger and garlic to make the teriyaki glaze.
Sear the chicken slices in a hot non-stick pan for 4 minutes until golden.
Pour in the glaze and cook 2 minutes until sticky and reduced.
Serve over the rice with broccoli and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Mango Banana Whey Recovery Smoothie
ingredients: 1 scoop (30 g) unflavored or fruit-free whey protein
directions: Add the milk and yogurt to the blender first so the powder does not stick to the bottom.
Add the whey, banana, mango and ice.
Blend on high for 45 seconds until completely smooth and thick.
Pour into a tall glass and drink within 30 minutes after your workout.

name: Tuna Avocado Whole-Wheat Wrap
ingredients: 1 can (140 g) tuna in water, drained
directions: Mash the avocado with lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Fold in the tuna and red onion until evenly combined.
Lay the spinach and carrot down the center of the tortilla and top with the tuna mixture.
Fold in the sides, roll tightly and slice in half on the diagonal.

name: Light Chicken Biryani Recovery Plate
ingredients: 180 g halal chicken thigh, boneless and cubed
directions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, biryani masala and turmeric for 30 minutes.
Fry the sliced onion in ghee until deep golden, then remove half for garnish.
Add the chicken and cook covered for 12 minutes until tender and the sauce thickens.
Layer the chicken over the rice, steam together 5 minutes and garnish with the fried onions and herbs.

name: Lemon Herb Baked Cod with Asparagus
directions: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a tray with parchment.
Arrange the asparagus on one side and toss with half the oil.
Place the cod on the other side, drizzle with lemon juice and the remaining oil, and add thyme, pepper and lemon slices.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until the fish flakes and the asparagus is just tender.

name: Thai Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups
directions: Cook the ground chicken in a dry pan over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Take off the heat and toss with lime juice, coconut aminos and chili flakes while still warm.
Stir in the shallot, mint, cilantro and toasted rice powder.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and serve immediately while crisp.

name: Light Mexican Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 baked corn tortilla, cut in strips
directions: Simmer the whole chicken breast in the broth with cumin and paprika for 15 minutes until cooked, then shred with two forks.
Add the tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer 8 more minutes.
Bake the tortilla strips at 200°C for 6 minutes until crisp.
Return the shredded chicken to the soup, ladle into a bowl and top with the strips and cilantro.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Egg Drop Soup
directions: Bring the broth to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms and cook 4 minutes.
Add the tofu and bok choy and cook 2 minutes more.
Stir the broth in a slow circle and pour in the beaten egg in a thin stream so it forms ribbons.
Season with coconut aminos and top with spring onion.

name: Orange Ginger Baked Salmon with Broccoli
ingredients: Juice of 1 orange plus 1 tsp zest
directions: Whisk the orange juice, zest, ginger, garlic and honey into a glaze.
Place the salmon in a baking dish, pour over half the glaze and marinate 15 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with olive oil and roast on the same tray at 200°C for 15 minutes with the salmon.
Brush the salmon with the remaining glaze for the final 3 minutes and serve.

name: Garlic Ginger Chicken Vegetable Broth
ingredients: 2 cups water or low-sodium chicken stock
1/2 cup cooked small pasta or rice
directions: Bring the stock to a gentle simmer with the garlic, ginger, carrot and celery.
Add the chicken breast, cover and poach 15 minutes until cooked through.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot with the pasta or rice.
Simmer 3 minutes, then finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Kiwi Spinach Green Immunity Smoothie Bowl
directions: Blend 1 kiwi with the spinach, banana, yogurt and orange juice until thick and spoonable.
Pour into a bowl and smooth the surface.
Slice the second kiwi into rounds and lay them in a row on top.
Scatter the pumpkin seeds and coconut flakes and eat right away.

name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl
directions: Toss the sweet potato with paprika and a little oil, then roast at 210°C for 25 minutes until caramelized.
Warm the black beans in a small pot with a splash of water and a pinch of salt.
Arrange the rice, sweet potato, beans and corn in sections of a bowl.
Add avocado and salsa, then finish with the lime juice.

name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
ingredients: 150 g extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
1 cup mixed bell peppers and snap peas
directions: Pan-fry the tofu cubes in a dry non-stick pan for 8 minutes, turning until all sides are crisp.
Push the tofu aside, add the sesame oil and stir-fry the mushrooms 2 minutes.
Add the peppers, snap peas and ginger and toss over high heat for 3 minutes so they stay crunchy.
Pour in the coconut aminos, toss with the tofu and serve on the rice with sesame seeds.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Tagine with Couscous
directions: Soften the onion in olive oil for 4 minutes, then stir in the ras el hanout until fragrant.
Add the squash, tomatoes, apricots and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and cook uncovered 8 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Pour 1/3 cup boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the tagine.

name: Lentil Walnut Bolognese with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely diced carrot and celery
directions: Sauté the carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the lentils, walnuts, passata and oregano and simmer 15 minutes until thick and rich.
Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, about 9 minutes, reserving a little pasta water.
Toss the pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water, and serve.

name: Palak Paneer with Whole-Wheat Roti
directions: Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 1 minute, then plunge into cold water and blend to a smooth puree.
Cook the onion in ghee until golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook until soft.
Pour in the spinach puree and garam masala and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes, warm through for 3 minutes and serve with the roti.

name: Caprese Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 large portobello mushroom caps, stems removed
1 tsp balsamic-free lemon vinaigrette (lemon juice and olive oil)
directions: Brush the mushroom caps with olive oil and garlic and roast gill-side up at 200°C for 10 minutes.
Drain any liquid released by the mushrooms.
Layer in the tomato slices and mozzarella and bake 8 minutes until the cheese melts.
Top with torn basil and the lemon vinaigrette before serving.

name: Mushroom Spinach Quesadilla with Fresh Salsa
directions: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil with cumin for 5 minutes until the moisture cooks off.
Add the spinach and stir 30 seconds until wilted.
Cover half the tortilla with cheese, add the vegetables, then fold over and press down.
Toast in a dry skillet for 2 minutes per side until golden and crisp, then slice into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Turkey and Kidney Bean Chili
directions: Heat the olive oil in a pot and soften the onion for 4 minutes, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the turkey and brown for 6 minutes, breaking it into small crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin, then add the tomatoes, broth and kidney beans.
Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until thick, stirring occasionally, and season with salt.

name: Za'atar Chicken Thighs with Roasted Chickpeas
ingredients: 2 halal bone-in chicken thighs, skin removed (about 220 g)
3/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and dried
directions: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Rub the thighs with za'atar, half the oil and the lemon juice.
Toss the chickpeas and tomatoes with the paprika and remaining oil on a tray and place the chicken on top.
Roast 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 74°C and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.

name: Chicken and Egg Fried Cauliflower Rice
directions: Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Scramble the eggs in the same wok for 1 minute and push to the side.
Add the carrot, peas and cauliflower rice and fry on high heat for 4 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the coconut aminos and sesame oil, toss for 1 minute and top with spring onions.

name: Almond Butter Toast with Strawberries
directions: Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread 1 tablespoon of almond butter on each slice while the toast is still warm.
Shingle the strawberry slices over the top.
Drizzle with honey, sprinkle with hemp seeds and eat 45 minutes before training.

name: Sweet Potato and Egg Breakfast Hash
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato (200 g), cut in 1 cm cubes
directions: Microwave the sweet potato cubes for 3 minutes to part-cook them.
Heat the oil in a skillet and fry the sweet potato for 6 minutes until browned.
Add the onion, pepper and paprika and cook 3 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes until the whites set, then top with parsley.

name: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal Cups
directions: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease 2 large muffin cups.
Mix the oats, milk, egg, cinnamon, baking powder and maple syrup, then fold in the apple.
Divide between the cups and top with the walnuts.
Bake 22 minutes until set and golden, and cool 5 minutes before eating.

name: Whole-Grain Pasta Salad with Chickpeas and Tomatoes
directions: Boil the penne in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente, then rinse under cold water.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a large bowl.
Add the pasta, chickpeas, tomatoes and cucumber and toss to coat.
Fold in the basil, sprinkle with parmesan and eat 90 minutes before exercise.

name: Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup
ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, halved and deseeded
directions: Roast the peppers, tomatoes, onion and garlic with the olive oil at 220°C for 30 minutes until charred at the edges.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins and put everything in a blender with the stock and basil.
Blend until smooth, then warm gently in a pot for 5 minutes.
Ladle into a bowl and swirl in the yogurt.

name: Citrus Chicken and Avocado Salad
ingredients: 1 tsp Dijon-free lemon mustard (lemon juice and mustard powder)
directions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper and pan-sear 6 minutes per side until cooked through, then rest and slice.
Whisk the orange juice, olive oil and lemon mustard into a dressing.
Arrange the greens on a plate with the orange segments and avocado.
Top with the chicken and pumpkin seeds and drizzle with the dressing.

name: Mushroom Barley Soup
directions: Brown the mushrooms in olive oil for 6 minutes without stirring too often.
Add the carrot, celery and garlic and cook 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock, barley and thyme and simmer partially covered for 35 minutes until the barley is tender.
Add a splash of water if too thick and season with salt and pepper.

name: Golden Turmeric Chia Pudding
directions: Whisk the chia seeds, coconut milk, turmeric, ginger, pepper and honey in a jar.
Rest 10 minutes, whisk again to break up clumps, then refrigerate at least 4 hours.
Stir and spoon into a glass.
Top with the mango and pumpkin seeds.

name: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
directions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, shawarma spice and lemon juice for 30 minutes.
Sear in olive oil over high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Thin the tahini with a splash of water and lemon juice to a drizzling sauce.
Serve the chicken over the rice with the tomato and cucumber and drizzle with tahini.

name: Baked Cod Tacos with Mango Salsa
directions: Rub the cod with chili powder, cumin, olive oil and salt and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until it flakes.
Mix the mango, red onion, lime juice and cilantro into a salsa.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Flake the fish into the tortillas and top with cabbage and mango salsa.

name: Cocoa Banana Protein Oat Shake
directions: Pour the milk into the blender first, then add the oats and let them soak for 2 minutes.
Add the whey, banana, cocoa, honey and ice.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until the oats are fully broken down and the shake is thick.
Pour into a tall glass and drink within 30 minutes after training.

name: Cucumber Chickpea Greek Salad
directions: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives and chickpeas in a wide bowl.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and oregano together.
Pour over the salad and toss gently.
Crumble the feta on top and serve immediately.

name: Grilled Chicken Fajita Salad
directions: Toss the chicken with the fajita seasoning and half the olive oil.
Sear in a hot skillet for 6 minutes until cooked and charred, then remove.
Cook the peppers and onion in the remaining oil for 4 minutes until tender with some char.
Pile the romaine in a bowl, top with the chicken and vegetables, and dress with salsa and lime juice.

name: Turkey-Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 2 medium bell peppers, tops cut off and deseeded
directions: Heat the oven to 190°C and stand the peppers upright in a small baking dish.
Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic for 6 minutes, then mix in the rice, half the tomatoes and the herbs.
Spoon the filling into the peppers and spread the remaining tomatoes on top.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, uncover, add the mozzarella and bake 8 minutes more.

name: Roasted Cauliflower Tahini Buddha Bowl
directions: Toss the cauliflower and chickpeas with olive oil, cumin and salt and roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until deeply golden.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of water into a pourable sauce.
Arrange the quinoa and kale in a bowl and top with the roasted vegetables.
Drizzle generously with the tahini sauce.

name: Vegan Red Lentil Dal with Basmati Rice
directions: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 1.5 cups water for 15 minutes until soft and creamy.
In a small pan, heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds until they sizzle, then add the onion and ginger until golden.
Add the tomato to the pan and cook 3 minutes until jammy.
Stir the tempering into the dal, season with salt, and serve over the rice with coriander.

name: Edamame Quinoa Power Bowl
directions: Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, drain and cool under running water.
Whisk the coconut aminos and rice vinegar for the dressing.
Arrange the quinoa, edamame, cucumber, cabbage and avocado in separate sections of a bowl.
Drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Hummus and Kale Stuffed Sweet Potato
directions: Pierce the sweet potato and bake at 200°C for 45 minutes until completely soft.
Sauté the kale in olive oil for 3 minutes, then add the lemon juice and chickpeas.
Split the potato lengthwise and fluff the flesh with a fork.
Fill with the kale mixture, top with hummus and dust with za'atar.

name: Spinach Ricotta Lasagna Rolls
directions: Boil the lasagna sheets for 8 minutes, drain and lay them flat.
Mix the ricotta, spinach, egg, garlic, nutmeg and a pinch of salt.
Spread the filling along each sheet, roll up and place seam-side down on a layer of passata in a baking dish.
Top with the remaining passata and mozzarella and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.

name: Vegetable and Egg Bibimbap
directions: Blanch the spinach for 30 seconds, squeeze dry and toss with a drop of sesame oil.
Sauté the carrot, zucchini and mushrooms separately for 2 to 3 minutes each so each keeps its color.
Fry the egg sunny-side up in a non-stick pan.
Arrange the vegetables over the rice, top with the egg and gochujang, sprinkle with sesame seeds and mix before eating.

name: Paneer Tikka Skewers with Mint Chutney
ingredients: 120 g paneer, cut in cubes (microbial rennet)
1/2 green bell pepper, cut in chunks
directions: Mix the yogurt, tikka masala and lemon juice and coat the paneer, pepper and onion; marinate 30 minutes.
Thread alternately onto skewers.
Grill or bake at 220°C for 12 minutes, turning once, until charred at the edges.
Blend the mint, coriander, chili and a splash of water with salt into a chutney and serve alongside.

name: Light Baked Eggplant Parmigiana
ingredients: 1 medium eggplant, sliced in 1 cm rounds
directions: Brush the eggplant slices with oil and bake at 220°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until browned and soft.
Warm the passata with the garlic for 5 minutes.
Layer the sauce, eggplant, basil and mozzarella in a small dish, repeating once, and finish with the parmesan and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken Tikka Protein Bowl with Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1/2 cup sliced red onion and tomato
directions: Mix 2 tbsp yogurt with the tikka masala and lemon juice, coat the chicken and marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or broil for 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the grated cucumber and mint into the remaining yogurt with a pinch of salt to make the raita.
Spoon the rice into a bowl, top with the chicken, onion and tomato, and serve with the raita.

name: Greek Yogurt Chicken Salad Stuffed Pita
ingredients: 150 g cooked halal chicken breast, shredded
directions: Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper together in a bowl.
Fold in the chicken, celery and grapes until evenly coated.
Warm the pita for 20 seconds and cut it open along one side.
Line the pocket with greens and fill with the chicken salad.

name: Lean Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
ingredients: 170 g halal lean beef sirloin, thinly sliced
directions: Toss the beef with the cornstarch and half the coconut aminos and rest for 10 minutes.
Blanch the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain.
Sear the beef in sesame oil over very high heat for 2 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the broccoli, remaining coconut aminos and water, and toss for 1 minute until glossy.

name: Egg White Veggie Breakfast Burrito
directions: Sauté the bell pepper in olive oil for 2 minutes and add the spinach until just wilted.
Pour in the whisked egg whites and whole egg and scramble gently for 2 minutes until just set.
Warm the black beans and the tortilla.
Fill the tortilla with eggs, beans and salsa, fold the sides in and roll tightly.

name: Mango Coconut Rice Pudding Cup
directions: Simmer the rice with the coconut milk and milk for 10 minutes, stirring often, until creamy.
Stir in the honey and cardamom and cool for 10 minutes.
Spoon into a cup and chill 30 minutes if you prefer it cold.
Top with the mango and coconut flakes and eat about 60 minutes before training.

name: Blueberry Oat Breakfast Smoothie
directions: Soak the oats in the milk for 5 minutes so they blend smoothly.
Add the blueberries, banana, yogurt, honey and cinnamon to the blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink 45 to 60 minutes before exercise.

name: Hummus and Roasted Pepper Whole-Grain Sandwich
ingredients: 1/2 cup roasted red peppers (jarred, in water)
directions: Toast the bread lightly so it holds the fillings.
Spread the hummus thickly on both slices.
Layer the roasted peppers, cucumber and arugula, then sprinkle with lemon juice and za'atar.
Close, press gently and slice diagonally.

name: Grilled Chicken Burrito Bowl with Cilantro Lime Rice
directions: Rub the chicken with chili powder, cumin and salt and grill 6 minutes per side until cooked through.
Toss the warm rice with the lime juice and cilantro.
Warm the beans and corn together in a small pot.
Slice the chicken and arrange over the rice with the beans, corn and pico de gallo.

name: Baked Salmon Rice Bowl with Cucumber and Edamame
directions: Brush the salmon with coconut aminos and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Stir the rice vinegar through the warm rice.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and drain.
Flake the salmon over the rice and arrange the edamame, cucumber and avocado around it, then sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Protein Parfait
directions: Whisk the whey into the yogurt until smooth and thick.
Spoon a third into a tall glass and add a layer of berries.
Add a layer of granola, then repeat the layers.
Finish with honey and chia seeds and eat within an hour after your workout.

name: Turkey and Egg Sweet Potato Skillet
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato (200 g), small cubes
directions: Pan-fry the sweet potato in olive oil for 8 minutes until golden and tender, then set aside.
Brown the turkey with the onion and paprika for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Return the sweet potato, add the kale and stir 2 minutes until wilted.
Make a well, crack in the egg, cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes until the white sets.

name: Ginger Cabbage and Chicken Soup
ingredients: 120 g halal chicken breast, thinly sliced
directions: Bring the broth to a simmer with the ginger and carrot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chicken slices and poach 5 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in the cabbage and cook 3 minutes until just tender.
Season with coconut aminos and top with spring onions.

name: Lemon Pepper Chicken with Garlic Green Beans
ingredients: 1 tbsp lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest
directions: Butterfly the chicken breast so it cooks evenly and rub it with pepper, lemon zest and salt.
Sear in 1 tsp olive oil for 5 minutes per side until cooked through, then add the lemon juice and rest 5 minutes.
In a second pan, sauté the green beans in the remaining oil for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic for the last minute and serve beside the sliced chicken.

name: Cauliflower Crust Veggie Pizza
ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella (microbial rennet), plus 1/4 cup for topping
directions: Microwave the riced cauliflower 4 minutes, cool, then wring it dry in a clean towel.
Mix with the egg, 1/4 cup mozzarella and oregano, then press into a thin round on parchment.
Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges.
Spread with passata, add the mushrooms, spinach, tomatoes and remaining cheese and bake 8 more minutes.

name: Spiced Turkey Zucchini Boats
directions: Scoop the flesh out of the zucchini halves, leaving a 1 cm shell, and chop the flesh.
Brown the turkey with the onion, cumin and coriander in olive oil for 6 minutes.
Add the chopped zucchini flesh and tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes.
Fill the shells and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, then sprinkle with parsley.

name: Carrot Ginger Soup with Coconut Swirl
directions: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the carrots and stock and simmer 20 minutes until the carrots are completely tender.
Blend until silky smooth and reheat gently.
Ladle into a bowl, swirl in the coconut milk and scatter the pumpkin seeds on top.

name: Citrus Quinoa Salad with Pomegranate
directions: Whisk the olive oil, orange juice and a pinch of salt into a dressing.
Toss the cooled quinoa with the spinach and dressing in a bowl.
Fold in the orange segments, pomegranate seeds and mint.
Top with the almonds and serve at room temperature.

name: Pomegranate Berry Yogurt Smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup pomegranate juice (100% juice, no additives)
directions: Pour the pomegranate juice and yogurt into the blender first.
Add the berries, banana, ginger and honey.
Blend for 45 seconds until smooth and a deep ruby color.
Pour into a chilled glass and serve right away.

name: Crispy Baked Falafel Bowl with Tahini Sauce
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and dried
directions: Pulse the chickpeas, parsley, garlic, onion, cumin and chickpea flour into a coarse, sticky mixture.
Shape into 6 small patties and bake at 210°C for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Serve the falafel over the bulgur with the tomato and cucumber and drizzle with tahini.

name: Vegan Tofu Pad Thai
directions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until pliable and drain.
Whisk the tamarind, coconut aminos and coconut sugar into a sauce.
Fry the tofu in oil for 6 minutes until golden, then add the carrot and noodles with the sauce and toss 2 minutes.
Add the bean sprouts for the last 30 seconds and serve with crushed peanuts and the lime wedge.

name: Wild Rice Stuffed Acorn Squash with Cranberries
ingredients: 1 small acorn squash, halved and deseeded
directions: Roast the squash cut-side down at 200°C for 30 minutes until tender.
Sauté the celery in olive oil for 3 minutes and mix in the rice, cranberries, pecans and sage.
Turn the squash over and season the cavity with salt.
Pack in the filling and bake 10 more minutes until hot.

name: Mushroom Walnut Lettuce Tacos
directions: Cook the mushrooms in a dry pan for 8 minutes until all their moisture evaporates and they brown.
Add the walnuts, chili powder and cumin and cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the black beans and lime juice and warm through.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves and top with diced avocado.

name: Margherita Whole-Wheat Flatbread
directions: Heat the oven to 230°C with a baking tray inside.
Spread the passata over the flatbread and add the tomato slices and mozzarella.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake 8 to 10 minutes until the crust is crisp and the cheese bubbles.
Finish with torn basil, olive oil and oregano.

name: Vegetable Pesto Pasta Primavera
ingredients: 1 tbsp basil pesto (pine nuts, olive oil, parmesan with microbial rennet)
directions: Boil the fusilli in salted water for 9 minutes, adding the asparagus and peas for the last 2 minutes.
Reserve a little pasta water and drain.
Sauté the zucchini and tomatoes in a dry pan for 4 minutes until lightly browned.
Toss everything with the pesto and a splash of pasta water and finish with parmesan.

name: Masala Omelette with Whole-Wheat Toast
directions: Whisk the eggs with the turmeric, cumin and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the onion, tomato, chili and coriander.
Heat the ghee in a non-stick pan, pour in the mixture and cook 2 minutes until the base sets.
Fold in half, cook 1 more minute and serve with the toast.

name: Lemon Dill Salmon Patties with Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: 1 can (170 g) wild salmon, drained and flaked
directions: Mix the salmon, egg, breadcrumbs, dill and lemon zest until it just holds together.
Shape into 3 patties and chill 10 minutes so they stay intact.
Pan-fry in olive oil over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden.
Stir the lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the yogurt and spoon over the patties.

name: Moroccan Spiced Turkey Burger in a Lettuce Bun
ingredients: 2 tbsp plain yogurt with a squeeze of lemon
directions: Combine the turkey, ras el hanout, mint, garlic and salt and form one thick patty.
Sear in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes per side until the center reaches 74°C.
Rest the patty 3 minutes.
Sandwich the patty with tomato and lemon yogurt between the two lettuce leaves.

name: Pear Cardamom Oat Porridge
directions: Simmer the oats and milk with the cardamom for 6 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in half the diced pear and cook 2 minutes more.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the remaining pear.
Drizzle with honey, scatter the almonds and eat about 60 minutes before training.

name: Peanut Sesame Soba Noodle Salad
directions: Boil the soba for 4 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, coconut aminos, rice vinegar and 1 tbsp warm water into a smooth dressing.
Toss the noodles with the carrot, cucumber and dressing.
Top with spring onion and sesame seeds and eat 90 minutes before exercise.

name: Whole-Wheat Banana Walnut Waffles
directions: Whisk the flour, baking powder and cinnamon in a bowl.
Mix the banana, egg and milk, then stir into the dry ingredients with the walnuts until just combined.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron for 4 minutes until crisp and golden.
Drizzle with honey and eat 60 minutes before your session.

name: Date Walnut Oat Energy Bites
directions: Pulse the dates, oats, walnuts, tahini and cinnamon in a food processor until the mixture clumps when pinched.
Roll into 6 balls with damp hands.
Coat each ball lightly in shredded coconut.
Chill 20 minutes and eat 3 bites about 30 minutes before training.

name: Lemon Ricotta Honey Toast with Blueberries
directions: Toast the bread until crisp.
Stir the lemon zest into the ricotta.
Spread the ricotta evenly over both slices.
Top with the blueberries, drizzle with honey and finish with pistachios.

name: Spiced Lamb Kofta Quinoa Bowl
directions: Mix the lamb, onion, cumin, coriander, parsley and salt and shape into 6 small ovals.
Cook in a dry non-stick pan 3 to 4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Stir the lemon juice into the yogurt.
Serve the koftas over the quinoa with the cucumber, tomato and yogurt sauce.

name: Chicken Pesto Whole-Wheat Penne
ingredients: 1 tbsp basil pesto (parmesan with microbial rennet)
directions: Boil the penne in salted water for 10 minutes until al dente, reserving a little water.
Sear the chicken in olive oil for 6 minutes per side until cooked through, rest and slice.
Blister the tomatoes in the same pan for 3 minutes and wilt in the spinach.
Toss the pasta with the pesto and a splash of pasta water, then top with the chicken and tomatoes.

name: Detox Cabbage and White Bean Soup
directions: Soften the carrot, celery and garlic in a splash of broth for 4 minutes.
Add the cabbage, remaining broth and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the white beans and cook 5 minutes more.
Finish with lemon juice and black pepper.

name: Baked Zucchini Fritters with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, grated and squeezed dry
1/2 tsp olive oil for the tray
directions: Mix the zucchini, egg, chickpea flour, feta and mint.
Drop 6 mounds onto an oiled tray and flatten slightly.
Bake at 210°C for 20 minutes, flipping at 12 minutes, until golden.
Stir the lemon juice into the yogurt and serve on the side.

name: Chicken Ginger Noodle Soup
directions: Simmer the broth with the ginger, garlic and star anise for 10 minutes.
Poach the chicken in the broth for 12 minutes until cooked, then lift out and shred.
Add the noodles and bok choy and cook 3 minutes.
Remove the star anise, return the chicken, then add the lime juice and cilantro.

name: Roasted Beet Orange Walnut Salad
directions: Wrap the beets in foil and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes until a knife slides in easily.
Cool, peel and cut into wedges.
Whisk the olive oil, orange juice, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Toss the arugula with the dressing, top with the beets, orange segments, walnuts and goat cheese.

name: Papaya Lime Yogurt Cup
directions: Toss the papaya with the lime juice and zest.
Stir the honey into the yogurt.
Layer half the yogurt, then half the papaya, into a glass and repeat.
Top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Garlic Mushroom Lentil Stew
directions: Brown the mushrooms in olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and thyme and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the kale and cook 3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper.

name: Lemon Ginger Chicken Congee
directions: Simmer the rice in the broth with half the ginger for 35 minutes, stirring now and then, until it breaks down into porridge.
Add the whole chicken breast for the last 15 minutes of cooking.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return to the pot.
Stir in the lemon juice and serve topped with spring onions, remaining ginger and sesame oil.

name: Coconut Chickpea Pumpkin Stew
ingredients: 1 cup cubed pumpkin or butternut squash
directions: Soften the onion and ginger in a splash of water for 4 minutes and stir in the curry powder.
Add the pumpkin, coconut milk and 1/2 cup water and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and cook 5 minutes more until the sauce thickens.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and serve over the rice.

name: Vegan Mediterranean Stuffed Eggplant
directions: Score the eggplant flesh, brush with olive oil and roast cut-side down at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a 1 cm shell, and chop it.
Mix the chopped flesh with the quinoa, chickpeas, tomato, garlic and cinnamon.
Fill the shells, top with pine nuts and bake 10 minutes, then finish with parsley.

name: Teriyaki Tempeh Quinoa Bowl
directions: Steam the tempeh for 8 minutes to remove any bitterness and pat dry.
Mix the coconut aminos, maple syrup and ginger into a glaze.
Pan-sear the tempeh for 3 minutes per side, add the glaze and cook 1 minute until sticky.
Serve over the quinoa with broccoli and cabbage and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Spinach Feta Egg Wrap
directions: Wilt the spinach in olive oil for 1 minute.
Pour in the whisked eggs with the oregano and scramble 2 minutes until just set.
Warm the tortilla and lay the eggs down the middle.
Add the tomato and crumbled feta, fold in the sides and roll.

name: Cauliflower Potato Masala with Chapati
directions: Crackle the cumin seeds in hot ghee, then cook the onion until golden.
Add the tomato, turmeric and coriander powder and cook 3 minutes.
Add the cauliflower, potato and 1/4 cup water, cover and cook 15 minutes until tender.
Uncover, dry out for 2 minutes and serve with the chapati.

name: Black Bean and Cheese Baked Enchiladas
directions: Heat the oven to 190°C and warm the tortillas so they bend without cracking.
Fill each with beans and peppers and roll up.
Place seam-side down in a dish, pour over the enchilada sauce and sprinkle with cheddar.
Bake 18 minutes until bubbling and finish with cilantro.

name: Halloumi and Zucchini Skewers with Herbed Couscous
directions: Thread the halloumi, zucchini and onion alternately onto skewers and brush with olive oil.
Grill 3 minutes per side until the halloumi is golden.
Pour 1/3 cup boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes and fluff.
Toss the couscous with the herbs and lemon juice and serve with the skewers.

name: Vegetable Khichdi with Cucumber Yogurt
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed diced carrot and peas
directions: Rinse the rice and dal together until the water runs clear.
Crackle the cumin in ghee, add the ginger and vegetables and stir 1 minute.
Add the rice, dal, turmeric, salt and 2 cups water and simmer covered 25 minutes until soft and porridge-like.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt and serve alongside.

name: Vegetable and Egg Fried Brown Rice
directions: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok for 1 minute and set aside.
Stir-fry the carrot, pepper and peas in sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add the cold rice and press it against the wok for 3 minutes to crisp slightly.
Return the eggs, add the coconut aminos and spring onions and toss for 1 minute.

name: Garlic Herb Chicken Meatballs with Tzatziki
directions: Mix the chicken, breadcrumbs, egg white, garlic, parsley, oregano and salt until just combined.
Roll into 8 meatballs and brush lightly with olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for 18 minutes until browned and the center reaches 74°C.
Stir the cucumber and dill into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and serve with the meatballs.

name: Seared Tuna Steak with Edamame Salad
directions: Press the sesame seeds onto both sides of the tuna and season with salt.
Sear in a very hot pan with the sesame oil for 90 seconds per side, leaving the center slightly pink if you like, or cook 3 minutes per side for well done.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, drain and cool.
Whisk the coconut aminos, vinegar and ginger, toss with the edamame, cabbage and cucumber, and serve with the sliced tuna.

name: Cottage Cheese Protein Pancakes
ingredients: 1 tsp olive oil for the pan
directions: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a little olive oil.
Pour in 1/4 cup portions and cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear, then flip and cook 2 minutes.
Serve topped with the raspberries.

name: Lean Beef Shawarma Salad
directions: Toss the beef with the shawarma spice, half the lemon juice and the olive oil and marinate 20 minutes.
Sear in a very hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Whisk the tahini, yogurt, remaining lemon juice and 1 tbsp water into a sauce.
Pile the romaine, tomato, cucumber and onion in a bowl, top with the beef and drizzle with the sauce.

name: Turkey Pesto Egg Muffins
ingredients: 1 tbsp basil pesto (parmesan with microbial rennet)
directions: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease 4 muffin cups.
Whisk the eggs with the pesto and pepper.
Divide the turkey, spinach and bell pepper among the cups and pour the egg over.
Bake 18 minutes until puffed and set in the center.

name: Honey Cinnamon Sweet Potato Toast with Ricotta
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato (200 g), sliced lengthwise 1 cm thick
directions: Toast the sweet potato slices 3 times in a toaster, or roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, until tender with crisp edges.
Spread the ricotta over the warm slices.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon.
Scatter the pecans and eat about an hour before training.

name: Pineapple Coconut Overnight Chia Oats
directions: Mix the oats, chia seeds, coconut milk, milk and honey in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 6 hours.
Stir in the morning and loosen with a splash of milk if needed.
Top with the pineapple and coconut flakes and eat 60 to 90 minutes before exercise.

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients: 1 medium potato (180 g), cut in wedges
directions: Toss the potato wedges with half the oil and the rosemary and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes.
Rub the chicken with garlic, lemon juice, remaining oil and salt and add to the tray.
Add the green beans and roast 20 minutes more until the chicken reaches 74°C and the potatoes are golden.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, slice and serve with the vegetables.

name: Spiced Beef Keema with Brown Rice
directions: Soften the onion in olive oil for 5 minutes and add the ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned.
Stir in the tomato, turmeric and garam masala and cook 5 minutes.
Add the peas and 1/4 cup water, simmer 5 minutes and serve over the rice with coriander.

name: Salmon Quinoa Salad with Lemon Dill Dressing
directions: Season the salmon with salt and pepper and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice and dill into a dressing.
Toss the quinoa, arugula, cucumber and tomatoes with half the dressing.
Flake the salmon over the salad and drizzle with the remaining dressing.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Recovery Smoothie
directions: Pour the milk into the blender and soak the oats in it for 2 minutes.
Add the whey, banana, peanut butter, cocoa and ice.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until thick and smooth.
Drink within 30 minutes after training.

name: Chicken Fajita Sweet Potato Boats
directions: Pierce the sweet potato and bake at 200°C for 45 minutes until soft.
Sear the chicken with the fajita seasoning in olive oil for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the pepper and onion and cook 4 minutes.
Split the potato, fill with the fajita mix, and top with yogurt mixed with lime juice and the cilantro.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Cups with Fresh Pico
directions: Brown the turkey in a dry non-stick pan for 6 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt and 2 tbsp water and cook 2 minutes.
Mix the tomato, onion, cilantro and lime juice into a pico de gallo.
Spoon the turkey into the lettuce cups and top with the pico.

name: Spaghetti Squash with Turkey Marinara
directions: Roast the squash cut-side down at 200°C for 40 minutes until tender, then shred the strands with a fork.
Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil for 4 minutes and add the turkey.
Brown 6 minutes, then add the tomatoes and basil and simmer 12 minutes.
Spoon the sauce over the squash strands.

name: Baked Haddock with Tomato Olive Relish
directions: Place the haddock on parchment, brush with 1 tsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Mix the tomato, olives, capers, garlic, parsley, lemon juice and remaining oil.
Spoon the relish over the fish.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Kebab Plate
directions: Mix the yogurt, sumac, paprika and salt and coat the chicken; marinate 30 minutes.
Thread the chicken and vegetables onto skewers.
Grill 12 minutes, turning, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are charred.
Serve over the greens with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Cucumber Dill Tuna Salad Boats
ingredients: 1 can (140 g) tuna in water, drained
1 large cucumber, halved lengthwise and seeded
directions: Scoop the seeds from the cucumber halves with a spoon to make shallow boats.
Mix the tuna, yogurt, dill, lemon juice, celery and olive oil with salt and pepper.
Pile the tuna salad into the cucumber boats.
Chill 10 minutes and serve.

name: Sweet Potato Turmeric Coconut Soup
directions: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil for 4 minutes and stir in the turmeric.
Add the sweet potato and stock and simmer 18 minutes until completely tender.
Blend until smooth, stir in the coconut milk and reheat gently.
Serve topped with pumpkin seeds.

name: Lemon Garlic Roasted Chicken with Brussels Sprouts
ingredients: 2 halal chicken drumsticks, skin removed (about 220 g)
1 lemon, half juiced and half sliced
directions: Heat the oven to 210°C.
Toss the chicken with garlic, lemon juice, half the oil, thyme and salt.
Toss the sprouts with the remaining oil and spread on a tray with the chicken and lemon slices.
Roast 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 74°C and the sprouts are caramelized.

name: Mixed Berry Spinach Flax Green Smoothie
directions: Pour the orange juice and yogurt into the blender first.
Add the spinach, berries, banana and flaxseed.
Blend 60 seconds until smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink right away.

name: Smoky Sweet Potato Black Bean Chili
directions: Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil for 4 minutes and stir in the paprika, chili powder and cumin.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes and stock and simmer covered 15 minutes.
Add the beans and simmer uncovered 10 minutes until thick.
Season with salt and serve hot.

name: Vegan Chana Masala with Brown Rice
directions: Cook the onion in olive oil for 6 minutes until golden and add the ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomato, turmeric and chana masala and cook 5 minutes until jammy.
Stir in the chickpeas and 1/3 cup water and simmer 12 minutes, lightly mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Serve over the rice with coriander.

name: Avocado Chickpea Smash Sandwich
directions: Mash the chickpeas and avocado together with the lemon juice, leaving some texture.
Fold in the red onion, parsley, salt and pepper.
Toast the bread and pile the spinach and cucumber on one slice.
Top with the smash, close the sandwich and cut in half.

name: Spinach Mushroom Crustless Quiche
directions: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a small pie dish.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in olive oil for 6 minutes, add the spinach to wilt, and cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs, milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper and stir in the vegetables and cheese.
Pour into the dish and bake 25 minutes until set and lightly golden.

name: Creamy Mushroom Spinach Whole-Wheat Pasta
directions: Boil the linguine in salted water for 9 minutes, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain.
Brown the mushrooms in olive oil for 6 minutes and add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in the milk, ricotta and a splash of pasta water and simmer 2 minutes into a creamy sauce.
Add the spinach and pasta, toss until wilted and finish with parmesan.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad with Yogurt Dressing
directions: Rub the chicken with olive oil, salt and pepper and grill 6 minutes per side until the center reaches 74°C, then rest 5 minutes and slice.
Whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, mustard powder and half the parmesan into a thick dressing, loosening with a teaspoon of water.
Toss the romaine with the dressing until every leaf is coated.
Top with the sliced chicken and croutons and finish with the remaining parmesan.

name: Baked Cod and Chickpea Tray Bake
ingredients: 3/4 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and dried
directions: Heat the oven to 210°C and toss the chickpeas, tomatoes and onion with half the oil and the paprika on a tray.
Roast 15 minutes until the tomatoes burst and the chickpeas turn crisp at the edges.
Nestle the cod into the tray, brush with the remaining oil and season with salt.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the fish flakes, then finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Harissa Chicken Skewers with Couscous Salad
directions: Mix the harissa and yogurt, coat the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Pour 1/3 cup boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, then fluff with the olive oil.
Fold the cucumber, parsley and lemon juice into the couscous and serve with the skewers.

name: Beef Meatball Marinara Zucchini Bake
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, sliced lengthwise into ribbons
directions: Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, basil, garlic and salt and roll into 8 small meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a dry oven-safe pan for 5 minutes, turning.
Lay the zucchini ribbons around the meatballs and pour the passata over everything.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until bubbling.

name: Mango Lassi Overnight Oats
directions: Stir the oats, yogurt, milk, chia seeds, cardamom and honey in a jar.
Fold in half of the mango, seal and refrigerate at least 6 hours.
Stir well in the morning and add a splash of milk if it has thickened too much.
Top with the remaining mango and eat 60 to 90 minutes before training.

name: Labneh, Date and Walnut Pita
directions: Warm the pita in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Spread the labneh evenly over the pita.
Scatter the sliced dates and walnuts on top and dust with cinnamon.
Drizzle with honey, fold and eat about an hour before exercise.

name: Quinoa Apple Almond Breakfast Bowl
directions: Warm the quinoa with the milk and cinnamon in a small pot for 4 minutes until creamy.
Stir in half the diced apple and cook 1 minute.
Spoon into a bowl and top with the remaining raw apple for crunch.
Finish with almonds and honey and eat 60 minutes before training.

name: Peach Cottage Cheese Toast
directions: Toast the bread until golden and firm.
Spread the cottage cheese over both slices.
Fan the peach slices on top.
Drizzle with honey, then add the pistachios and cinnamon.

name: Steamed Cod with Ginger Rice and Bok Choy
directions: Place the cod on a heatproof plate, scatter with half the ginger and steam over boiling water for 8 minutes.
Steam the bok choy alongside for the last 3 minutes.
Warm the sesame oil with the remaining ginger and coconut aminos for 1 minute.
Serve the fish and bok choy over the rice and spoon the warm ginger sauce on top with spring onion.

name: Grilled Chicken Hummus Wrap
directions: Rub the chicken with sumac and salt and grill 6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice thinly.
Spread the hummus across the warm tortilla.
Layer the romaine, cucumber, tomato and chicken and squeeze over the lemon juice.
Fold in the ends, roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Beef and Lentil Shepherd's Pie with Sweet Potato Topping
directions: Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes until soft, drain and mash with salt and pepper.
Brown the beef with the onion for 6 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste, thyme and stock.
Add the lentils, carrot and peas and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Spoon into a dish, cover with the mash, rough up the top with a fork and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes.

name: Zucchini Noodle Chicken Stir-Fry
directions: Stir-fry the chicken in sesame oil over high heat for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through, then set aside.
Add the garlic, ginger, pepper and carrot to the wok and cook 3 minutes.
Return the chicken with the coconut aminos and toss for 1 minute.
Add the zucchini noodles for just 90 seconds so they stay crisp and serve at once.

name: Turkey Cabbage Roll Skillet
directions: Brown the turkey with the onion in a dry skillet for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and paprika and stir 30 seconds.
Add the cabbage, tomatoes and broth, cover and simmer 15 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Uncover for 3 minutes to thicken and finish with dill.

name: Shirazi Salad with Grilled Chicken
directions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper and a little lime juice and grill 6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Combine the cucumber, tomato, onion and mint in a bowl.
Dress with the remaining lime juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Serve the chicken over the salad with the toasted pita broken into pieces.

name: Spinach Mushroom Egg White Omelette
directions: Sauté the mushrooms in olive oil for 4 minutes until browned and add the spinach for 30 seconds.
Whisk the egg whites and whole egg with salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Cook gently 2 to 3 minutes until nearly set, sprinkle with feta and fold in half.
Serve with the toast.

name: Citrus Fennel Salmon Salad
directions: Season the salmon and bake at 200°C for 12 minutes until it flakes.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, orange juice and a pinch of salt into a dressing.
Toss the arugula, fennel and quinoa with the dressing.
Top with the orange segments and flaked salmon.

name: Kale White Bean Lemon Soup
directions: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the stock and half the beans and simmer 10 minutes.
Mash the remaining beans into the broth for body and add the kale.
Cook 5 minutes until the kale is tender and stir in the lemon juice off the heat.

name: Turmeric Mango Lassi
directions: Pour the milk and yogurt into the blender first.
Add the mango, turmeric, ginger, pepper, honey and ice.
Blend for 45 seconds until frothy and smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and serve immediately.

name: Peanut Tofu Lettuce Wraps
directions: Pan-fry the crumbled tofu in a dry non-stick pan for 7 minutes until golden and dry.
Whisk the peanut butter, coconut aminos, lime juice and 1 tbsp warm water into a sauce.
Toss the tofu with half the sauce and the rice.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves, top with carrot and cabbage and drizzle with the remaining sauce.

name: Chickpea Tikka Masala with Cauliflower Rice
directions: Soften the onion in olive oil for 4 minutes and add the ginger-garlic paste and spice mix for 1 minute.
Pour in the passata and simmer 8 minutes until darker and thick.
Stir in the coconut milk and chickpeas and cook 8 minutes.
Steam the riced cauliflower in a covered pan with a splash of water for 4 minutes and serve under the curry.

name: Lemon Herb White Bean and Farro Salad
directions: Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the warm farro and red onion so they absorb the dressing.
Fold in the beans, tomatoes and cucumber once the farro has cooled slightly.
Stir through the herbs and serve at room temperature.

name: Spanakopita-Style Egg Cups
directions: Heat the oven to 190°C and brush 3 muffin cups with olive oil.
Cut each phyllo sheet into 3 squares, layer 2 squares into each cup and press in to form a shell.
Wilt the spinach in a dry pan for 1 minute, squeeze out the moisture and mix with the spring onion, dill and feta.
Divide the filling among the cups, crack an egg into each and bake 15 minutes until the whites are set.

name: Paneer Bhurji Wrap
directions: Crackle the cumin seeds in ghee, then cook the onion 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tomato, peas, turmeric and garam masala and cook 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down.
Stir in the paneer and cook 3 minutes until heated through and fragrant.
Warm the tortilla, fill with the bhurji and coriander and roll tightly.

name: Black Bean and Queso Fresco Stuffed Sweet Potato
directions: Pierce the sweet potato and bake at 200°C for 45 minutes until completely soft.
Warm the black beans with the cumin and a splash of water for 5 minutes, lightly mashing a few.
Split the potato open and fluff the flesh.
Fill with the beans, then top with queso fresco, avocado, lime juice and cilantro.

name: Mushroom Stroganoff over Whole-Wheat Noodles
directions: Boil the noodles in salted water for 7 minutes and drain.
Brown the mushrooms in olive oil for 7 minutes, then add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and paprika, pour in the stock and simmer 5 minutes.
Take off the heat, stir in the yogurt so it does not curdle, and spoon over the noodles with parsley.

name: Tandoori Chicken Lettuce Wraps with Mint Yogurt
ingredients: 200 g halal chicken breast, cut in strips
4 large romaine or butter lettuce leaves
directions: Mix 2 tbsp yogurt with the tandoori masala, lemon juice and salt, coat the chicken and marinate 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in a very hot non-stick pan for 6 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the mint and a pinch of salt into the remaining yogurt.
Fill the lettuce leaves with chicken, onion and cucumber and spoon over the mint yogurt.

name: Egg and Turkey Breakfast Scramble Bowl
directions: Microwave the sweet potato for 2 minutes to soften it.
Brown the turkey with the onion and paprika in olive oil for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Add the sweet potato and cook 3 minutes until lightly crisp, then stir in the spinach.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble gently for 2 minutes until just set.

name: Pan-Seared Trout with Lemon Caper Quinoa
ingredients: 1 tbsp lemon juice plus 1 tsp zest
directions: Pat the trout dry, season with salt and pepper and sear skin-side down in 1 tsp olive oil for 4 minutes until crisp.
Flip and cook 2 minutes until just opaque.
Toss the warm quinoa with the capers, lemon zest, lemon juice, parsley and remaining oil.
Serve the trout over the quinoa with the green beans.

name: Apricot Pistachio Couscous Bowl
directions: Place the couscous and apricots in a bowl and pour over the warm milk.
Cover and let stand 5 minutes until the milk is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and stir in the cinnamon.
Top with the pistachios and honey and eat about 60 minutes before training.

name: Banana Cinnamon French Toast
directions: Whisk the egg, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak each slice of bread for 20 seconds per side.
Cook in a lightly oiled non-stick pan for 3 minutes per side until golden.
Top with the banana slices and maple syrup and eat 60 minutes before exercise.

name: Strawberry Almond Oat Smoothie
directions: Soak the oats in the milk for 5 minutes so they blend smoothly.
Add the strawberries, almond butter, yogurt and honey to the blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until smooth.
Drink 45 to 60 minutes before training.

name: Corn and Black Bean Rice Bowl
directions: Warm the beans and corn together in a small pot for 4 minutes.
Toss the rice with the lime juice and cilantro.
Spoon the beans and corn over the rice.
Top with avocado and salsa and eat about 90 minutes before exercise.

name: Garlic Chicken and Broccoli Brown Rice Bowl
directions: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and half the coconut aminos.
Sear in sesame oil over high heat for 5 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Add the garlic and broccoli with 2 tbsp water, cover and steam 3 minutes.
Stir in the remaining coconut aminos and serve over the rice.

name: Lamb and Chickpea Stew with Couscous
directions: Brown the lamb in a dry pot for 5 minutes and add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cinnamon, then add the tomatoes and 1/2 cup water.
Cover and simmer 40 minutes until the lamb is tender, adding the chickpeas for the last 10 minutes.
Pour 1/3 cup boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the stew and parsley.

name: Tuna Niçoise-Style Potato Salad
ingredients: 1 can (140 g) tuna in water, drained
directions: Boil the potato for 10 minutes, adding the green beans for the last 3 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Toss the warm potato and beans with half the dressing.
Top with the tuna, egg, tomatoes and olives and drizzle with the remaining dressing.

name: Chicken and Black Bean Quesadilla
ingredients: 120 g cooked halal chicken breast, shredded
directions: Mix the chicken, beans, pepper and cumin.
Sprinkle the cheese over half the tortilla, add the filling and fold over.
Toast in a dry skillet for 3 minutes per side until crisp and golden.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Shredded Chicken Cabbage Slaw Bowl
ingredients: 150 g halal chicken breast, poached and shredded
1.5 cups shredded green and purple cabbage
directions: Poach the chicken in simmering salted water for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred.
Whisk the rice vinegar, coconut aminos and sesame oil into a dressing.
Toss the cabbage, carrot and cilantro with the dressing.
Top with the chicken and sesame seeds.

name: Tomato Basil Chicken Zoodle Soup
directions: Soften the garlic in olive oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and whole chicken breast and simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot.
Add the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes and finish with basil.

name: Roasted Veggie and Egg Breakfast Bowl
directions: Toss the broccoli, zucchini and pepper with olive oil, paprika and salt and roast at 210°C for 20 minutes.
Poach or soft-boil the eggs for 6 to 7 minutes.
Place the quinoa in a bowl and add the roasted vegetables.
Top with the eggs and squeeze over the lemon juice.

name: Orange Carrot Ginger Smoothie
directions: Add the water and yogurt to the blender first.
Add the carrot, orange, banana, ginger and ice.
Blend for 60 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink right away.

name: Cream of Broccoli Soup with Greek Yogurt
directions: Soften the onion and garlic in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add the potato, broccoli and stock and simmer 15 minutes until everything is tender.
Blend until silky and return to low heat.
Stir in the yogurt and lemon juice off the heat so it does not split.

name: Mushroom Spinach Chicken Garlic Stir-Fry
directions: Stir-fry the chicken in sesame oil over high heat for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the mushrooms and cook 4 minutes until browned.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the coconut aminos.
Fold in the spinach until just wilted and serve at once.

name: Sweet Potato Kale Quinoa Salad with Citrus Dressing
directions: Roast the sweet potato with half the olive oil at 210°C for 25 minutes until caramelized.
Whisk the remaining oil, orange juice, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Massage the kale with 2 tbsp of the dressing for 1 minute until softened.
Toss with the quinoa and sweet potato, drizzle with the remaining dressing and top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Smoky Lentil Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
directions: Warm the lentils in olive oil with the paprika, cumin, salt and 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with the lentils, slaw and avocado.

name: Curried Chickpea Salad Wrap
directions: Mash the chickpeas roughly with a fork, leaving some whole.
Stir in the tahini, curry powder, lemon juice, salt, apple and raisins.
Lay the spinach down the center of the tortilla and spoon the chickpea salad on top.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.

name: Sesame Ginger Tofu Soba Bowl
directions: Boil the soba for 4 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Pan-fry the tofu in a dry non-stick pan for 7 minutes until golden on all sides.
Wilt the bok choy in the same pan with the ginger for 2 minutes.
Toss the noodles with the sesame oil and coconut aminos, top with the tofu and bok choy, and finish with sesame seeds and spring onion.

name: Quinoa and Black Bean Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 medium bell peppers, tops removed and deseeded
directions: Heat the oven to 190°C and stand the peppers in a small baking dish.
Mix the quinoa, beans, corn, half the tomatoes, cumin and chili powder.
Fill the peppers and spoon the remaining tomatoes on top.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes, uncover for 5 minutes and finish with cilantro.

name: Ricotta Zucchini Whole-Wheat Pizza
directions: Heat the oven to 230°C.
Mix the ricotta with the garlic and lemon zest and spread over the base.
Arrange the zucchini slices on top, brush with olive oil and add the mozzarella.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is crisp and the cheese is golden, then scatter with basil.

name: Vegetable Egg Curry with Basmati Rice
directions: Cook the onion in olive oil for 6 minutes until golden and add the ginger-garlic paste.
Add the tomato, curry powder and turmeric and cook 5 minutes until jammy.
Stir in the peas and 1/2 cup water and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the halved eggs, warm through 2 minutes and serve over the rice with coriander.

name: Caprese Quinoa Salad with Basil Pesto
ingredients: 1 tbsp basil pesto (parmesan with microbial rennet)
directions: Toss the cooled quinoa with the pesto and lemon juice until evenly coated.
Fold in the tomatoes and mozzarella pearls.
Arrange the arugula in a bowl.
Pile the quinoa mixture on top and serve at room temperature.

name: Baked Chicken Seekh Kebab with Mint Chutney
ingredients: 1/4 cup mint chutney (mint, coriander, yogurt, lemon)
directions: Mix the chicken, egg white, grated onion, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, coriander, green chili, fresh coriander and salt, kneading for 2 minutes until sticky.
Chill the mixture for 20 minutes so it holds its shape on the skewers.
Mold into 4 long kebabs around skewers and bake at 220°C for 18 minutes, turning once, until browned and the center reaches 74°C.
Serve with the mint chutney and the onion and cucumber salad.

name: Lean Chicken Karahi with Ginger and Tomatoes
ingredients: 220 g halal chicken thigh, skinless, boneless and cubed
directions: Heat the oil in a karahi or wok and sizzle the cumin seeds for 20 seconds.
Add the chicken and half the ginger and garlic and sear on high heat for 6 minutes until the pieces turn white and lightly golden.
Add the tomatoes, crushed coriander seeds, green chilies and salt, cover and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes until the oil separates and the sauce thickens.
Stir in the remaining ginger and fresh coriander and serve with the roti.

name: Baked Beef Chapli Kebab with Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1 small tomato, finely diced and drained
directions: Mix the beef, tomato, onion, fresh coriander, green chili, coriander seeds, pomegranate seeds, chickpea flour and salt well.
Shape into 2 flat round patties about 1.5 cm thick and chill 15 minutes.
Bake on a lined tray at 220°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp at the edges and cooked through.
Stir the cucumber into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and serve with the kebabs and roti.

name: Seviyan Kheer with Almonds and Cardamom
directions: Warm the ghee in a small pot, add the vermicelli and toast on low heat for 2 minutes until it smells nutty.
Pour in the milk, add the cardamom and simmer for 8 minutes, stirring often, until the vermicelli is soft and the kheer thickens.
Stir in the raisins and honey and cook 1 minute more.
Top with the almonds and eat warm about 60 to 90 minutes before training.

name: Banana Date Sweet Lassi
directions: Pour the milk and yogurt into the blender first.
Add the banana, dates, cardamom and ice.
Blend for 45 to 60 seconds until the dates break down and the lassi is frothy.
Pour into a tall glass, top with pistachios and drink 45 to 60 minutes before exercise.

name: Chicken Yakhni Pulao with Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 180 g halal chicken, bone-in pieces with skin removed
directions: Simmer the chicken in 2 cups water with half the ginger-garlic paste, the cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and salt for 25 minutes, then strain and keep the yakhni (stock).
Fry the onion in ghee until golden, add the cumin and remaining paste and cook 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and the drained rice with 1 cup of the hot yakhni, bring to a boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes, fluff, and serve with the cucumber stirred into the yogurt.

name: Palak Gosht with Whole-Wheat Roti
directions: Brown the onion in ghee for 5 minutes, then add the ginger-garlic paste, turmeric and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and tomato with 1/2 cup water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes until the meat is tender.
Blanch the spinach for 1 minute, blend to a coarse puree and stir into the pot.
Cook uncovered for 8 minutes until thick and serve with the roti.

name: Chicken Tikka Whole-Wheat Roti Roll
ingredients: 1 large whole-wheat roti or paratha-style wrap
directions: Mix 2 tbsp yogurt with the tikka masala, lemon juice and salt, coat the chicken and marinate 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the mint chutney into the remaining yogurt.
Warm the roti, spread with the chutney yogurt, add the chicken, onion, cucumber and tomato, then roll tightly.

name: Baked Fish Tikka with Kachumber Salad
ingredients: 200 g firm white fish fillet (cod or rohu), cubed
directions: Mix the yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, ajwain, chili powder, half the lemon juice and salt, coat the fish and marinate for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and bake at 220°C for 12 minutes, turning once, until the edges are lightly charred and the fish flakes.
Toss the cucumber, tomato, onion and coriander with the remaining lemon juice and a pinch of salt for the kachumber.
Serve the fish tikka on the salad.

name: Lauki Chicken Curry
directions: Crackle the cumin seeds in the oil, then cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, tomato, turmeric and coriander powder and cook 4 minutes until the tomato breaks down.
Add the chicken and sear 4 minutes, then add the bottle gourd and 1/4 cup water.
Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the gourd is tender, then finish with fresh coriander.

name: Pakistani Chicken Vegetable Shorba
ingredients: 2 cups water or low-sodium chicken stock
directions: Warm the ghee, add the ginger-garlic paste, pepper and cumin and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour in the stock, add the whole chicken breast and carrot and simmer 15 minutes.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot with the cabbage and peas.
Simmer 5 minutes, then finish with the lemon juice and coriander.

name: Haldi Doodh (Golden Turmeric Milk)
directions: Heat the milk in a small pot with the turmeric, ginger, pepper and cinnamon over low heat.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes, whisking, without letting it boil over.
Strain into a mug and let it cool for 2 minutes so the honey keeps its properties.
Stir in the honey, top with the crushed almonds and sip warm.

name: Masoor Daal Soup with Lemon and Cumin
directions: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric, ginger and 2.5 cups water for 20 minutes until completely soft.
Blend roughly with a hand blender for a thick, soupy texture.
Heat the oil in a small pan, crackle the cumin seeds, then fry the onion, garlic and tomato for 4 minutes.
Stir the tempering into the soup and finish with the lemon juice and coriander.

name: Chana Chaat with Tamarind and Mint
directions: Toss the chickpeas, potato, tomato, onion and cucumber in a large bowl.
Add the chaat masala, cumin, green chili and salt.
Drizzle in the tamarind chutney and lemon juice and mix gently.
Fold in the mint and coriander and serve right away so the vegetables stay crisp.

name: Baingan Bharta with Whole-Wheat Roti
ingredients: 1 whole-wheat roti (made with water, no ghee)
directions: Char the whole eggplant directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning, until the skin blackens and the flesh collapses.
Cool slightly, peel and mash the flesh with a fork.
Crackle the cumin in the oil, cook the onion 5 minutes, then add the ginger-garlic paste, chili, turmeric and coriander powder.
Add the tomatoes and cook 6 minutes, stir in the eggplant and cook 5 minutes more, then finish with coriander and serve with the roti.

name: Sarson Saag with Makki Ki Roti
directions: Simmer the mustard greens, spinach, onion, ginger-garlic paste and green chili in 1/2 cup water for 20 minutes until very soft.
Blend coarsely, stir in the cornmeal and cook 8 minutes until thick, then finish with the ghee.
Knead the makki flour with warm water and a pinch of salt into a smooth dough, pat into a 15 cm round between your palms and cook on a hot griddle 3 minutes per side.
Serve the roti with the saag and a bowl of yogurt.

name: Anda Bhurji with Whole-Wheat Roti
directions: Heat the ghee, crackle the cumin seeds and cook the onion and green chili for 3 minutes.
Add the tomato, turmeric and chili powder and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Pour in the lightly beaten eggs with salt and stir gently for 2 minutes until softly scrambled.
Finish with coriander and serve with the warm roti.

name: Yellow Daal Tarka with Jeera Rice
ingredients: 1/3 cup chana daal (split chickpeas), soaked 1 hour
directions: Boil the soaked daal with the turmeric, tomato, salt and 2 cups water for 35 minutes until soft, mashing lightly with a spoon.
Warm 1/2 tsp ghee in a pan, crackle 1/4 tsp cumin seeds and toss the rice with it for 2 minutes to make the jeera rice.
For the tarka, heat the remaining ghee, add the rest of the cumin, the garlic and the dried chili and fry about 45 seconds until the garlic turns golden.
Pour the tarka over the daal, add the lemon juice and coriander, and serve with the jeera rice.
